install.expires: The links work for 15 minutes; get new ones any time.
install.hint: An edge runs on a computer of the tenant and links to this site. What it keeps private stays on that computer.
install.manual.hint: The same by hand. Windows: venv\Scripts\python instead of venv/bin/python. The catalog then lives in the system's application-data folder.
install.sameplace: Keep both files in one folder: the installer checks the package against its SHA-256.
install.step.download: Download the installer and the package below, into the same folder.
install.step.first: On its first start the edge fetches what it still lacks; after linking, what its tenant already knows.

link.adminonly: Only a tenant's admins can link an edge.
link.approve.hint: Approve only if you started this pairing on that machine. An approved edge works for the tenant until you revoke it in Settings.
link.approved: Approved. The edge will finish linking within a few seconds.
link.askadmin: Ask an admin of your tenant to open this link.
link.code.hint: The code the edge shows. It is valid for 10 minutes.
link.denied: Denied. The edge has been told.
mfa.off: Two-step sign-in is off. It is optional for members and required for admins.
mfa.on: Two-step sign-in is on: each sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.required: You manage a tenant or the platform, so two-step sign-in is required. Set it up once with an authenticator app.
mfa.scan: Scan this with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password …), or type the key.
